checkpoint.title: Route 4 east to Cerulean's Pokemon Center

events.why: east along Route 4's upper road to above the ledge row 9
down the ledge (93, 9) to the lower road
east into Cerulean City, to (9, 20) below column 9
west along row 20 to the Pokemon Center's door (22, 19)

checkpoint: Route 4 east of Mt. Moon (Route4 map.json) joins Cerulean City at its east end (x 107; Route 4's row 3 is the city's row 13). Its upper road (rows 2..8) reaches the city only by water: the way on by land is down the ledge row 9 at x 90..96 to the lower road (rows 10..12), which joins the city's rows 20..22. Lass Crissy (75, 3) faces east, sight 4, over row 3 from x 76 to 79; the way east keeps out of her line and off the grass south of the road (75..87, 11..17).

A ledge is taken as one step the way it faces, from the tile before it: the player hops it and lands two tiles on. Planned routes never hop a ledge (they hold into walls, and a held ledge hops), so where the only way on is down a ledge the row takes it as this one step.
cerulean_entry: The open leg east across the city's edge ended a tile short on the console (2026-11-03: on (6, 20), not (7, 20)), and no hold to a wall in the city's west end finds the player from there: the next hold south met the fence on (6, 23) and the walk went on a column off. So the entry ends on (9, 20), and only legs to walls follow.
above_city_ledge: North up column 9 (or 8, a tile short) to row 12, west to (8, 12), east to (30, 12) beside the policeman (31, 12), south to (30, 17), west to (25, 17). The way keeps out of the boy's (16, 18..24) and the balding man's (8..10, 22..24) wander boxes.
